model: SERAPIS (modular inflation; vacuum at a fixed point of the torus shape)
status: Frozen predictions, scored only on data published after 15 Nov 2026. A proposed model, not an established result.
star_mapper_role: The Star Mapper does not test SERAPIS (an early-universe model makes no prediction for individual Milky Way stars). It is the project's open-data survey: it verifies Gaia DR3 against ESA and feeds the AEGIS Sky Map with flagged stars and discovery categories (rules locked in PREREG_D716).
